_readme: Pre-loaded knowledge for ExpertAI: what a good trainer already knows about each role and tool before meeting the expert. Roles map to knowledge/roles/<id>.md, software to knowledge/software/<id>.md, baseline rules to knowledge/baseline-rules.json. Nothing here is company-specific; the expert's own words always win.

roles.name: Retail cashier, returns desk
roles.summary: Takes returns and exchanges at the counter: checks the receipt, the item, and the window, then refunds the right way or escalates.

roles.name: Accounts payable clerk, invoice approval
roles.summary: Verifies supplier invoices against purchase orders and goods receipts, codes them, and approves, holds, or sends them up.

roles.name: Customer support agent, tier 1
roles.summary: Works the ticket queue: first response inside the SLA, solves what tier 1 can, refunds within limits, escalates the rest.

roles.name: Front desk receptionist, hotel check-in
roles.summary: Checks guests in and out: verifies ID and a card, assigns rooms, handles upgrades and fee waivers within limits.

roles.name: HR onboarding coordinator
roles.summary: Gets a new hire from signed offer to day one: I-9, W-4, direct deposit, background check, equipment, and system access, on time.

roles.name: Insurance claims intake specialist
roles.summary: Takes first notice of loss: confirms the policy was active, captures the facts, requests documents, assigns an adjuster, and flags fraud signals.

roles.name: Scheduling coordinator
roles.summary: Books, moves, and cancels appointments without double-booking a provider, and applies cancellation and no-show rules fairly.

roles.name: Bookkeeping assistant
roles.summary: Categorizes transactions, chases receipts, reconciles bank accounts, and never touches a closed period without the bookkeeper.
